ABOUT THE COMPANY

Apria Healthcare’s mission is to improve the quality of life for our patients at home. We are looking for empathetic, thoughtful and compassionate people, to meet the needs of our patients. Already an industry leader in healthcare services, we provide home respiratory services and select medical equipment to help our patients sleep better, breathe better, heal faster, and thrive longer.

JOB SUMMARY

The Sleep Coach helps CPAP patients build confidence and consistency with their sleep therapy. In this remote-based role, you’ll connect with patients throughout their first year of therapy to answer questions, provide guidance, and help them work through the challenges that can make it difficult to use their equipment consistently.

You’ll use patient usage information, coaching techniques, and your knowledge of sleep therapy to understand each patient’s needs and provide practical solutions. You’ll also help patients understand their therapy, insurance requirements, equipment care, mobile resources, and future resupply needs.

This is a remote-based position that is a good fit for someone who enjoys working with people, communicating one-on-one, and helping patients take an active role in their health.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Proactively and reactively contact patients throughout their first full year of CPAP therapy.

• Make and receive inbound and outbound calls to coach, educate, and encourage patients as they adjust to CPAP therapy.

• Identify barriers that may be affecting a patient’s ability to use their therapy consistently and provide practical tools and solutions to help overcome them.

• Use manufacturer software to review patient usage information and make each patient conversation more informed and personalized.

• Use knowledge of obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) to help patients understand their therapy and the potential benefits of consistent use.

• Develop a basic understanding of PAP and mask equipment from various manufacturers to assist with common troubleshooting questions.

• Encourage patients to take an active role in their therapy, including using manufacturer mobile apps and other available resources.

• Help patients understand insurance requirements, equipment cleaning, and future resupply needs.

• Verify patient demographics, physician information, and notification preferences during each patient interaction.

• Accurately document patient conversations, questions, concerns, and next steps in the patient account.

• Share ideas and identify opportunities to improve the patient experience and support business growth in a positive and constructive manner.

• Maintain compliance with HIPAA guidelines.

• Perform other duties as required.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education and/or Experience

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Knowledge of or experience working with patients diagnosed with OSA is preferred.

• Experience working with various insurance plans, including HMO, PPO, and Medicare, is preferred.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES

• Patient-Focused: You enjoy helping people and take the time to understand their needs, concerns, and goals.

• Action-Oriented: You are comfortable working independently, taking initiative, and finding practical solutions with minimal supervision.

• Collaborative: You work well with others and contribute to a positive team environment, even while working remotely.

• Effective Communicator: You communicate clearly and comfortably with patients by phone and can explain information in a simple, easy-to-understand way.

• Energetic and Passionate: You care about helping people improve their health and bring a positive attitude to your interactions.

• Relationship Builder: You build trust with patients and create positive relationships through consistent and thoughtful communication.

COMPUTER SKILLS

• Moderate proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Access, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project, Visio, and Word.

• Comfortable learning and using manufacturer software and other digital tools.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

• English proficiency, including reading, writing, and verbal communication.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

• Moderate mathematical proficiency, with the ability to understand, interpret, and work with spreadsheet data.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

This is a stationary position that requires frequent sitting or standing, repetitive wrist motions, grasping, speaking, listening, close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus. It also may require occasional lifting, carrying, walking, climbing, kneeling, bending/stooping, twisting, pulling/pushing, walking, bending, stooping, and reaching above the shoulder. This position also may require the occasional lifting of equipment up to 50 lbs.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4. ABOUT THE COMPANY Republic Services, Inc. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer. Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment. Driven : We deliver results in the right way. Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs. Environmental Solutions Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need. The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Account Director - Job Description

You're a relationship builder and growth driver, leading the charge on client partnerships that go beyond the brief and beyond expectations. This is a pivotal role for an account leader who thrives at the intersection of client ambition, creative excellence, and business results, who can help brands grow with confidence, clarity, and momentum. You own a portfolio of culturally ambitious clients, partnering closely with strategy, creative and production leadership to ensure the work is not only breakthrough, but brilliantly delivered. You're the connective tissue that keeps big ideas moving and clients coming back.

The Account Director will be responsible for the following:

Client Growth

•

Build long-term relationships with your clients by learning their business, adding value and building trust

•

Drive growth across your client portfolio through organic expansion and deepened scopes of work, with accountability to annual growth targets

•

Leverage our Earned by Design ethos to proactively identify opportunities to expand Mint's impact across experiences, content and campaigns

•

Show up as an integrated leader and thinker - able to speak to our services across experience, content and campaigns as well as navigate the agency departments through the creative process to deliver strong work

Client Leadership

•

Act as the day-to-day senior partner across your accounts, building strong relationships at multiple levels of the client organization

•

Elevate the level of strategic partnership and service, ensuring our work is consistently solving real business problems

•

Advocate for the creative process, educating clients on what's required to get to the best product and the best impact

•

Become and expert on your client’s business to build long-term relationships grounded in trust, clarity, and results

Integrated Delivery

•

Ensure work across your accounts is connected across strategy, creative, and production - nothing falling through the cracks

•

Champion an approach that is insight-led, culturally relevant, and results-driven

•

Keep teams resourced, aligned, and moving efficiently, supporting AI implementation across planning, development, execution, and reporting

Business, Operations and Finance

•

Contribute to portfolio-level P&L with accountability to monthly KPI results across your accounts

•

Lead SOW development and scope management for your clients, handling scope creep conversations with clarity and confidence

•

Contribute to forecasting, revenue tracking, and profitability across your portfolio

Team & Culture

•

Support and mentor account team members with clarity, accountability, and care

•

Partner with leadership and People & Culture on individual growth plans for account team members

•

Contribute to training and mentorship initiatives that upskill and inspire the broader account team

•

Show up as a culture carrier: celebrating wins, reinforcing standards, and setting the tone

What Success Looks Like

•

A portfolio that is growing, both in revenue and in the quality of the work

•

Clients who see Mint as a true strategic partner, not just a vendor

•

Work that is creatively strong and commercially effective

•

An account team that is aligned, confident, and set up to do its best work

Looking Ahead

This role is central to how we're building Mint for the future. An account practice that is more integrated, more strategic, and more ambitious in the relationships we build and the impact we drive.

About Mint

We’re an independent creative agency made up of culture creatures with multidisciplinary expertise across all major marketing disciplines.

Driven by creativity and inspired by humanity, we focus on brand love between companies and people. Our best work is done through true partnership, as an extension of and advisor to our clients. Guided by core structure, we build bespoke teams to collaborate on our clients’ individual business problems to produce creative work that makes a positive impact on culture and the future.

Our Values

•

Empathy - We believe the work is better when we consider the world through others' eyes.

•

Optimism - We believe in the good above all else; the good in people, the good in the world and the good in our future.

•

Audaciousness - We are brave enough to try the untried and unexpected. And we dare to always follow through.

•

Progressiveness - We fear the status quo, so we break conventions and push to evolve, innovate and disrupt.

•

Kindness - We are respectful, honest, transparent, inclusive, social and good to each other.

Nothing in this job description is intended to limit or reduce any minimum employment standards or entitlements under the Ontario Employment Standards Act, 2000, as amended.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $120,000. Individual compensation within this range is determined based on job-related factors such as experience, skills, level of responsibility, internal equity, and business needs. This range represents the expected base salary for this role and does not include other elements of Mint’s total rewards program.
